thread:
Sophia (PM): quick sync — need alignment on the ISV bundle footprint for LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors + gateway adapters before the partner demo next week. main asks: sandbox image, runtime shim, telemetry contract, billing labels, and signing/attestation.
Liam (Eng): can we get a short acceptance checklist? esp for Private (VPC/on-prem) constraints — network/egress and KMS expectations.
Anya (Partner Eng): putting a checklist draft here, happy to iterate:
- minimal shim: single HTTP entry with /health and /invoke
- docker image <= 1.2GB (quantized runtime + adapter)
- manifest: `redwood.integrations.yaml` with: name, version, models, runtime_profile, telemetry_endpoint
- smoke tests: local and cloud (credentials-free)
- attestation: sha256 + signed image (we accept cosign)
Liam (Eng): +1 on cosign. For KMS: require an env var mapping to customer KMS alias for Private installs, document it.
devops-bot: registry check OK — tag found: ghcr.io/isv/sample-ll-index-adapter:v0.3.1 (size 1.18GB) :white_check_mark:
Maria (Legal): heads-up — co-marketing quote & logo TOU needs 72h review. also ask partner to sign the marketplace listing terms (we can share template).
Anya (Partner Eng): sample manifest (drop-in):
```yaml
name: ll-index-adapter
version: 0.3.1
runtime_profile: "redwood-shim-v1"
models: ["llama-3-mini", "redwood-curie-lite"]
telemetry_endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/ingest
billing_labels: {component: "adapter", cost_center: "isv-pilot"}
```
Nick (PM): can we slot a 30m call tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize checklist and demo script? @Sophia @Liam
Sophia (PM): yes — booked 10:30 PT. agenda: acceptance checklist, attestation flow, marketplace asset timeline (Maria to confirm legal window). :calendar:
Liam (Eng): I'll bring a local smoke script and the signing steps. Anya — can you ping the partner to push signed image by EOD?
Anya (Partner Eng): pinged them in the thread, they said they can cut a signed build today and we can run the smoke tests after.
Sophia (PM): perfect. post-call action items: 1) publish checklist to partner workspace, 2) run smoke tests in CI, 3) hand-off marketplace assets to marketing/legal. thanks everyone :rocket:
